sam_dev: FYI — customer saying the rerank endpoint returns 400/422 or all-zero scores when they copy the cURL from Console. they pasted the exact snippet into Windows cmd and got a parse error.

sam_dev: here is the exact curl they used (copied from Console):
```bash
curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank\" \\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  -d '{\n    \"query\": \"what is the refund policy\",\n    \"candidates\": [\"full refund\", \"partial refund\",],\n    \"top_k\": 3\n  }'
```

sam_dev: server reply was: `HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request` + `JSON parse error at position 87` and body: `{ \"error\": \"unexpected token ',' at line 1\" }`

maria_support: thanks — couple small things jumping out: 1) trailing comma after \"partial refund\" will break strict JSON parsers, 2) Windows cmd.exe does not support single quotes for args, so the payload can get split and end up malformed. can you repro in bash vs cmd? :thinking_face:

maria_support: quick repro steps to ask the customer: 1) save payload to file `req.json` (recommended), 2) run `curl -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" --data-binary @req.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank` (this avoids shell quoting issues).

sam_dev: ok will try. also noticed Console \"Copy cURL\" uses single quotes in the -d snippet and a trailing comma — probably the source of the issue.

alan_eng: yep that's my bad — the console snippet was auto-generated by the UI formatter; a template change slipped a trailing comma when candidates.length === 2 and it used single quotes to keep the snippet compact.

alan_eng: quick notes:
- Bash example with single quotes is fine.
- cmd.exe requires double quotes; Powershell accepts single or double but escaping differs.
- trailing comma is invalid JSON and will yield parse errors or cause servers to return 400.

alan_eng: proposed immediate fixes: remove trailing comma from generator, add platform-specific cURL variants (bash, powershell, cmd), and add a note recommending `--data-binary @file` for Windows users. i can push a tiny patch.

kevin_docs: please do. the docs should explicitly show three copy buttons (Bash, PowerShell, Windows CMD) and an inline tip: "If you see a JSON parse error after pasting cURL, try saving the payload to a file and use `--data-binary @req.json` or use the PowerShell variant with double quotes and escaped inner quotes." I'll update the guide and add a short troubleshooting blurb.

sam_dev: repro steps from my Windows VM: when I paste the Console snippet into cmd.exe it becomes `-d { \"query\": \"...\" -H Content-Type: application/json` (quotes stripped) -> 400. using the cmd-specific example with double quotes works. win cmd is wild. :sweat_smile:

maria_support: thanks, can you paste the minimal working cmd example you used so I can send to the customer?

sam_dev: sure — this worked for me in cmd.exe:```
curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer %REDWOOD_KEY%\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d \"{ \\\"query\\\": \\\"refund policy\\\", \\\"candidates\\\": [\\\"full refund\\\", \\\"partial refund\\\"], \\\"top_k\\\": 3 }\"
```

maria_support: perfect — sending to customer now. i'll include the `--data-binary @req.json` fallback and the note about trailing commas.

deploy-bot: PR #1448 opened by alan_eng to fix console cURL generator (remove trailing comma, add platform variants).

kevin_docs: i'll link PR #1448 in the docs changelog and add a short example for rerank input limits (max candidates note) — customers sometimes get \"scores all zero\" if candidate list is empty or if model truncation occurs.

sam_dev: great, thanks everyone. i'll follow up with the customer after docs patch lands and confirm they're unblocked. :thumbsup:
